label: Faithful standard-indicator baseline

design.encoder: released SPFormer sparse U-Net backbone (shape-compatible pretrain load)
design.loss: Hungarian matching BCE/Dice plus the published indicator and semantic losses
design.purpose: Reproduce a strong ScanRefer baseline inside AdaRES_project before adding new mechanisms.

profile_pilot.protocol: Fixed first 4 ScanRefer validation scenes, seed 1999, 108 expressions
profile_pilot.note: Efficiency-protocol pilot only; full validation mIoU remains 0.502.

conclusion: The faithful standard-indicator implementation is a stable strong baseline, improving AdaRES-B0 by 0.169 mIoU and finishing 0.013 below the project target.
